scope: Reconciliation manifest for the twelve regional Achievement Diary research packages. It inventories factual research and proposed normalization only. It does not rank diaries, select a route, alter production data, infer account readiness, or resolve disputed mechanics.

source_reference_coverage.central_registry_status: Package-local source catalogs are internally complete. Many use IDs not yet registered in research/sources.json, or current-page aliases for existing registry IDs; production integration must reconcile those before introducing fact records.

region_identity.account_state_rule: Use the exact display-name keys already required by scripts/evaluate_progression.py DIARY_REGIONS for account_state.diary_tiers. Do not replace those keys with slugs.
region_identity.artifact_slug_rule: Use region_slug from input_set.region_inventory only in new IDs. A slug is an identifier namespace, not an account-state key.

task_identity.source_task_id_rule: Retain every package task.id unchanged as the research traceability key. The 488 supplied IDs are globally unique.
task_identity.no_implicit_output_rule: A task action may add only its own task milestone and sourced deterministic consumptions or fixed XP. It must not award random loot, a combat kill, crop output, minigame points, daily collections, charges, collection-log progress, or a completed tier.

tier_claim_identity.claim_precondition_pattern: all current-tier task milestones, every preceding-tier claim milestone, and a player-confirmed in-game claim event
tier_claim_identity.reason: The current evaluator treats diary_tiers as externally confirmed observations, while several packages propose actions that derive a claimed tier from task milestones. Preserve the external-observation rule unless a focused model change and tests explicitly approve a different policy.

lamp_reporting.transition_rule: Report a player-chosen XP award; do not apply gain_xp until the recipient skill is explicitly selected.

reward_item_and_capability_identity.charged_or_daily_rule: Represent a charge, daily quantity, proc chance, cooldown, or variable output as a capability and a separately observed state when the account schema supports it. Do not turn it into a free repeatable action or an inventory grant.
reward_item_and_capability_identity.current_item_rule: Where an existing model already uses a single current-tier item, preserve that ID and reference it rather than adding four competing item nodes.

graph_edge_patterns.from: verified prerequisite condition or existing canonical node
current-tier task milestones and preceding claim state

graph_edge_patterns.to: claimed tier state, lamp entitlement, reward item, or durable capability

graph_edge_patterns.rule: Reference its existing node/action; never recreate its travel, charge, counter, combat, crop, or minigame mechanics.
Never use produces for a random drop.

package_schema_variation.normalization_requirement: Extract a normalized tier from tasks[].tier or the containing tiers[].tier before creating canonical task keys.

forms: top-level skills, quests, gates, and items
package_schema_variation.normalization_requirement: Normalize every requirement into typed predicates and every consumed, reusable, optional, or alternative input into a structured input list. Preserve a source text field for requirements that cannot yet be represented by the engine.

Map to one enum: deterministic, player_confirmed_skill_success, player_confirmed_encounter, player_confirmed_pvp, external_farming_state, daily_or_charge_state, variable_or_rng, or mixed. Never infer a more permissive result from missing detail.
Create one tier-reward record with tier, item, lamp, capabilities, source IDs, and existing-reference IDs.
The central registry must use publisher, kind, URL, checked_at, and use. Retain package-specific notes in an integration provenance field rather than silently discarding them.
Treat all package proposals as inputs to the canonicalization contract above, not as executable production action definitions.

existing_canonical_references.reference_reconciliation: The package names two non-existent action IDs ending in -current and -monastery-teleport. Map only after the central integrator confirms the three listed existing actions are the intended counterparts.
Reuse existing Camulet, carpet, eagle, redirected-tablet, Pyramid Plunder, and Kalphite access records; task milestones must not recreate those mechanics.
Motherlode, Prospector, Warriors' Guild, balloon, and existing transport facts are dependencies only. The hard Motherlode reward conflict is a blocker below.
Do not duplicate Fremennik quest, kingdom, balloon, eagle, Trollheim, or Lunar mechanics.
Waterfall Dungeon, fairy-ring, Barbarian Assault, player-owned house, and Lunar systems remain external canonical dependencies.
Preserve the current Karamja lamp exception and model Brimhaven, Fight Cave, and crop results as observed boundaries.

Memoir pages and charges, Xeric's Heart alternatives, Rada's blessing, Ash sanctifier, POH, Wintertodt, and Tithe Farm have existing ownership or state models. Add only unrepresented diary tasks after exact action deduplication.
Explorer's Ring, daily limits, and the Bones to Peaches task are already modeled. The package must contribute only remaining task research and claim completeness, not parallel actions or nodes.
Reuse existing Kharyrll, Ectophial, farming, Barrows, Slayer, and transport records as dependencies rather than creating alternate access models.

The package's named Museum-Kudos and Digsite-pendant action IDs are descriptive rather than exact current IDs. Map them to the listed actions or add a factual reference only after checking the intended behavior.
Pest Control credit, Void ownership, chompy counters, farming state, teleport-crystal charges, and boss kills need their own observed-state or ownership records.
Preserve existing hard-diary lesser-boss-lair access and model matching Slayer-task access as a separate alternative. Do not imply PvP survival, extraction, drops, or collection-log progress.

source_registry_reconciliation.source_gap_policy: Catalog-only packages may be integrated as region-level fact records after registry reconciliation, but a per-task production action should not be generated automatically unless it has either a task-level source ID or an explicit package-level inheritance rule recorded in the new diary package schema.

universal: Temporary boosts are allowed only where the current task source permits them; explicit non-boostable requirements remain hard gates.
Combat levels, items, and nominal access never prove an encounter victory or safe traversal.
RNG sources use makes_obtainable or a player-confirmed event; they never create deterministic inventory, collection-log, or kill effects.
Recurring/daily rewards, charges, cooldowns, crop timers, disease, yield, and minigame currency require dedicated observed state before they become executable transitions.
Player-versus-player availability, risk tolerance, survival, and extraction are observations, not requirements automatically satisfied by a Wilderness location node.

package_specific.boundary: combat kills, catches, thefts, and boss/minigame wins are player-confirmed
farming maturity, protection, disease, and harvest are external farming observations
daily allowances, charges, and chance effects are capabilities, not free repeatable outputs
chompy/jubbly thresholds, Pest Control credit, Void ownership, and boss kills stay explicit account observations
elite boss-family sequencing needs staged-progress state; a different diary update resets staged progress

blockers_before_automatic_normalization.issue: There is no diary-package JSON schema, and the twelve packages use multiple incompatible field layouts.
blockers_before_automatic_normalization.required_resolution: Add a research-only diary package schema and a validator that accepts the existing package provenance while requiring normalized task, claim, source, and boundary fields for future packages.

blockers_before_automatic_normalization.issue: Package source catalogs are internally valid but many IDs are absent from research/sources.json or are current-page aliases for existing canonical IDs.
blockers_before_automatic_normalization.required_resolution: Resolve the alias/addition table without changing URLs or checked dates by assumption.

blockers_before_automatic_normalization.issue: Automatic claims proposed by packages conflict with the current external diary-tier observation model.
blockers_before_automatic_normalization.required_resolution: Adopt and test one claim policy before any tier claim action is emitted.

blockers_before_automatic_normalization.issue: Package proposals use diary_task and milestone notions that do not exactly match the current allowed action kinds and the JSON action schema lags the runtime's diary-tier effect support.
blockers_before_automatic_normalization.required_resolution: Choose an existing action kind or add one deliberately, then align data/schemas/progression-action.schema.json, scripts/apply_action.py, scripts/validate_data.py, and focused tests.

blockers_before_automatic_normalization.issue: Some package references name non-existent or descriptive production action IDs.
blockers_before_automatic_normalization.required_resolution: Confirm behavior-level equivalence before mapping package labels to current action IDs.

blockers_before_automatic_normalization.issue: Current shared Falador Hard Motherlode text conflicts with the research package's current-page account.
blockers_before_automatic_normalization.required_resolution: Perform the separately specified authoritative-source resolution; do not choose the package value silently.

blockers_before_automatic_normalization.issue: The packages correctly retain these as observations, but the account model does not yet represent every required counter, charge, crop, boss sequence, or daily reset.
blockers_before_automatic_normalization.required_resolution: Integrate factual capability records now if sourced; defer executable transitions until a bounded observation model exists.

blockers_before_automatic_normalization.issue: The package records staged boss-family progress that resets after an unrelated diary update. Independent durable kill milestones would be incorrect.
blockers_before_automatic_normalization.required_resolution: Add a dedicated observed staged-progress state or retain the task as player-confirmed, non-generated research.

blockers_before_automatic_normalization.issue: Nine packages provide catalog-level rather than per-task source references.
blockers_before_automatic_normalization.required_resolution: Add a documented inheritance rule in the diary schema or enrich the individual tasks before generating production actions.

facts_safe_to_integrate_directly.fact: The twelve-package set contains 488 tasks with the exact region and tier counts in input_set.region_inventory.
conditions: Keep this as an audited research inventory, not a claim that all task mechanics are normalized.

facts_safe_to_integrate_directly.fact: All packages agree that a completed task can establish its own durable milestone without fabricating variable rewards or unrelated account state.
conditions: Do not use for tier claim transitions until B003 is resolved.

facts_safe_to_integrate_directly.fact: Combat success, RNG, recurring/daily counters, charges, crop life cycles, PvP outcomes, and collection-log progress are explicit observations or probabilistic acquisition paths.
conditions: Existing detailed facts remain authoritative where they already exist.

facts_safe_to_integrate_directly.fact: Lamps are player-chosen XP awards, with the Karamja values and recipient thresholds as the documented exception.
conditions: Reference achievement-diary-universal-claim-and-fixed-lamps; do not generate immediate XP without an explicit recipient selection.

facts_safe_to_integrate_directly.fact: The stale claims listed in duplicate_concepts_and_conflicts.stale_claims_to_preserve_as_corrections are intentionally retained with current-package alternatives.
conditions: The Falador Motherlode correction remains excluded pending B006.

integration_waves.work: Add canonical source entries and explicit aliases from source_registry_reconciliation; do not change package source IDs in this wave.
expected_tests: parse all twelve package JSON files

integration_waves.work: Resolve only the Falador Motherlode claim against the specified authority and preserve a dated stale-claim note.
Create research-traceable region and tier factual records only. Reference existing systems; add no generated actions or graph edges.
Create factual records for unrepresented tasks and tier benefits. Keep Kourend memoir, Xeric's, POH, Rada's, and Ash sanctifier as references to existing models.
Create only unrepresented factual records and explicit links to existing Explorer's Ring, Bones to Peaches, Kudos, Digsite, transport, farming, and POH records.
Create factual capability and observation-boundary records only. Exclude auto-generated combat, PvP, boss, Void, counter, and staged-progress transitions.

Implement the settled task/claim policy in a single controlled integration after regional factual records are available. Preserve current canonical actions and avoid bulk generated action insertion until model behavior is tested.

before_merge: Parse every package and this manifest as JSON.
Recompute the twelve region task counts and require totals of 488, 134 easy, 152 medium, 125 hard, and 77 elite.
Require globally unique source task IDs and generated canonical task/action/milestone IDs.
Require every task or claim source reference either to be in its package catalog or to use an explicitly recorded catalog-inheritance rule.
Require every production fact source ID to be in research/sources.json.
Reject non-ASCII content and trailing whitespace in the manifest and all packages.
after_each_wave: Confirm git diff changes only the wave's target files; do not absorb concurrent workspace changes.
Commit only the completed wave after its validation passes.
